reversible.admin.tools.tsx:regenerate: rewrites D1 rows from the artifact, idempotent
reversible.admin.tools.tsx:sync-ask: asks AI Search to read the corpus from D1 now; nothing is deleted here, and the index follows the database's own rows
reversible.admin.tools.tsx:reset-ask-budget: a counter; see the report, no data is lost

reversible.sync_ask: asks AI Search to read the corpus from D1 and waits for that sync; nothing is deleted here, the index follows the database's own rows, and it reports a read-back of the counts
reversible.save_procedure: creates or edits a procedure file through compile.mjs, the validator CI runs; the file and its git history stand, its D1 row and search records are derived, and there is no delete branch
reversible.refresh_citations: replaces rows of a DERIVED table (the citation counts, read from OpenAlex) and has no delete branch: a DOI that fails keeps its count. Idempotent, and the failures come back in the response
reversible.check_publications: a read of ORCID, Crossref and the publication rows; writes nothing
reversible.sync_media: the media index, on sync_ask's terms: derived, idempotent, read back
reversible.sync_posts: D1 rows, on sync_ask's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent
reversible.sync_procedures: D1 rows, on sync_posts's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent, and it refuses an empty file set rather than deleting every row
reversible.sync_dictionary: D1 rows, on sync_pages's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent, it refuses an empty file set rather than deleting every row, and it refreshes the one page row each entry opens through the page compile
reversible.sync_pages: D1 rows, on sync_procedures's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent, and it refuses an empty file set rather than deleting every row
reversible.sync_publications: D1 rows, on sync_procedures's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent, it refuses an empty file set rather than deleting every row, and it seeds a citation row only where none exists
reversible.sync_llms: the llms.txt settings row, on sync_procedures's terms: derived from the repository file, idempotent, read back, and it refuses a repository with no llms.txt rather than deleting the row
reversible.sync_cv: D1 rows, on sync_pages's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent, it refuses an empty file set rather than deleting every row, and it rewrites the CV's search records from the rows it converged
reversible.sync_cv_pdf: ONE derived object in OG, replaced by a put and never deleted: derived from D1's CV, idempotent (an object carrying the data's fingerprint is left alone), the put is conditional on the object read, and a failed render changes nothing stored
reversible.sync_roster: D1 rows, on sync_pages's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent, and it refuses an empty file set rather than deleting every row
reversible.sync_phages: D1 rows, on sync_pages's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent, it refuses an empty file set rather than deleting every row, and it re-derives the one page that embeds the table from the final set before any row moves
reversible.sync_registry: D1 rows, on sync_pages's terms: derived from the repository, idempotent, and it refuses an empty file set while rows exist rather than deleting every row (with no files and no rows there is nothing to converge)

passed_to.app/lib/health/response.server.ts:r2Chec: site-runtime's /health check: one bucket.head() of a fixed probe key, and nothing else
